column1: # Lama Temple and Hama: Xian to Altin continuity, Hsu rescue, Jupiter Reveal, desert warnings. Event endings preserved.

column3: Mind the loose rock!{page_break}One wrong blow\ncould bring down\nthe ceiling.{end_wait}

Those who see
what eyes conceal
may find the truth.{page_break}So the inscription
reads.{end_wait}

Welcome to Lama Temple.
Rest while you can.{page_break}Beyond us lies Lamakan
Desert. Its heat is
not to be taken lightly.{end_wait}
Have you come here\nfrom the east?{end_now}
Then you must have come\nacross Lamakan Desert...{end_wait}
Did you stop at Xian\non your way here?{end_now}

Master Feh in Xian
is an old friend of
our Master Hama.{page_break}His students often
come here to continue
their training.{end_wait}

Then you came to the
right place.{page_break}Master Feh teaches
strength. Here, we
teach how to guide it.{end_wait}
Do you know what\nmeditation is?{end_now}

Then you know how
hard it can be to
quiet your thoughts.{page_break}Some spend years
learning to do just
that.{end_wait}

To meditate is to
set aside the noise
of the world.{page_break}It sounds simple.
Try it, and you will
find otherwise.{end_wait}
You who speak to me...\nI sense great insecurity\nand anxiety within you.{end_wait}
Have you heard of\nMaster Hama's skill\nwith Chi?{end_now}

Then perhaps you met
Master Feh in Xian.{page_break}Even he admits that
Hama's gifts go far
beyond martial arts.{end_wait}
Then you may be\nsurprised by what\nyou see here.{end_wait}
They look weary.\nLamakan will test them\nmore than they know.{end_wait}
Kung fu teaches the\nbody to endure.{page_break}The mind needs\ntraining of its own.{end_wait}
He's thinking about\nfood again. Perhaps\nhe should eat first.{end_wait}
Chi is only one of\nMaster Hama's gifts.\nHer wisdom runs deeper.{end_wait}
Master Hama is\nmeditating. Please\nspeak quietly.{end_wait}
Do you believe she\nexpected us?{end_now}
But how did she know\nwe'd arrive today?{end_wait}
I don't believe her,\n{actor_name:1}. Why would\nshe say that?{end_wait}
I saw a glimpse of\nyour arrival some\ntime ago.{end_wait}
You really saw us\ncoming?{end_wait}

I've waited a long
time to meet you.{page_break}You're pursuing the
Elemental Stars,
aren't you?{end_wait}
You know about the\nStars? Then who\nare you?{end_wait}
Wait... I'm not a\nJupiter Adept.\nAm I?{end_wait}
You can read minds,\ncan you not?{end_wait}
Mind Read is a gift\nof Jupiter Psynergy.{end_wait}
And seeing us arrive...\nIs that Psynergy, too?{end_wait}
Some Jupiter Adepts\ncan sense what may\nlie ahead.{end_wait}
Not every glimpse\nfeels like a vision.\nYou will understand.{end_wait}
Seeing the future...\nI didn't know Jupiter\ncould do that.{end_wait}
It shows what ordinary\nsight cannot. I have\nwaited to teach it.{end_wait}
You waited here all\nthis time to teach\n{actor_name:3} Reveal?{end_wait}
On the road ahead,\nwhat you cannot see\nmay hurt you most.{end_wait}
Jupiter Adepts can\nlearn Reveal in time,\neven without a teacher.{end_wait}
But time is something\nyou cannot spare while\nSaturos moves ahead.{end_wait}
Saturos and his\ncompanions blocked\nSilk Road behind them.{end_wait}
A burden?\nWhat do you mean?{end_wait}
That is his story\nto tell. I cannot\ntell it for him.{end_wait}
For now, we must\nspeak of Reveal.{end_wait}
You will need it to\ncross Lamakan Desert.{page_break}The heat is not all\nthat is wrong there.{end_wait}
Do you think the desert\nitself has changed?{end_now}
You think so,\n{actor_name:1}? Then what\nchanged it?{end_wait}
I hope you're right,\n{actor_name:1}. But Hama\nseems worried.{end_wait}
Then how will Reveal\nhelp us get across?{end_wait}
Lamakan was always\ndangerous. Its heat\ncould kill the unwary.{end_wait}
Now the air itself\nseems to burn. The\nheat has grown worse.{end_wait}
Go in unprepared,\nand you may never\ncome out.{end_wait}
Then how did Saturos\nmanage to cross it?{end_wait}
Saturos and Menardi\nare Mars Adepts.{end_wait}

Fire is their element.
They may endure heat
that would kill us.{page_break}But I cannot
be certain.{end_wait}
Reveal won't make\nthe desert cooler.\nHow does it help?{end_wait}
It will show you\noases hidden from\nordinary sight.{end_wait}
Why would the oases\nbe hidden? They're\nright out in the open.{end_wait}
Do you know what\na mirage is?{end_now}

Then you know that
heat can trick the eye.{page_break}In Lamakan, it can
hide the water you
need to survive.{end_wait}

Heat bends the light.
What seems like water
may be only sand.{page_break}Reveal can help you
find real oases
through the haze.{end_wait}
Good. I'd rather not\ndie of thirst in\nthe middle of nowhere.{end_wait}
I can try. But I\ncannot promise that\nthe power will take.{end_wait}

In preparation for
this day, I tried to
pass a power on{page_break}to a young girl,
although that power
was not Reveal.{end_wait}
She was not an Adept.\nI feared I had\nasked too much.{end_wait}
Still, I believed\nthe power might\nbe within her.{end_wait}
For a long time,\nthere was no sign\nof change.{end_wait}
Feizhi? What brings\nyou back here?{end_wait}
What did you sense?{end_wait}
Hsu left Lama Temple\nsome time ago.{end_wait}
I know! But he never\nmade it home to Xian.{end_wait}
The boulders in\nthe mountain pass...{end_wait}
I came through\nthe mine to find you.\nPlease, help him!{end_wait}
But why did your\npower awaken only now?{end_wait}
When the gems fell\nfrom the sky, one\nstruck my head.{end_wait}
Then perhaps the gift\nwas there all along.\nIt needed a spark.{end_wait}
Yes. We must find\nhim at once.{end_wait}
Wait! What about\nReveal?{end_wait}
It seems I succeeded in\npassing my power to\nFeizhi. You will be fine.{end_wait}
There. Reveal is yours.\nUse it to cross\nthe desert.{end_wait}
But it will take\npractice. You may not\nsee every oasis yet.{end_wait}
No... But somehow,\nshe doesn't feel\nlike a stranger.{end_wait}
Then let's get moving!{end_wait}
The desert may have\nslowed them down. But\nwe cannot count on it.{end_wait}
We can't leave\nHsu trapped out there!{end_wait}
Hama and Feizhi\nmight need our help.{end_wait}
